meta_description:
6,560 likes, 27 comments - ishitamangal on October 4, 2026: "45 days ago, I was doing 10K in 1 hour 25 minutes. Today I did it in 1 hour🥹🏃‍♀️⚡ Training 5–6 days a week under the guidance of my coach has helped me get here much faster than I ever expected. Forever grateful to @neilsingh09 for giving me the best training pattern and to @manveindrasingh for basically forcing me to sign up for every race possible 😂🤝

Ran the Sekhon India Air Force 10K Race today ✈️🇮🇳 The race goodies and arrangements were absolutely top notch. The only struggle was the number of people walking right in front of us at the start, which made it difficult to find a clear passage and build pace initially. But every race teaches me something new mostly that my body is capable of doing things my brain had already declared impossible 😂 This one was AMAZING. Another race in 2 weeks. Watch out. 👀🔥🏃‍♀️ @sekhoniafmarathon 

#10KRun #RunningJourney #RaceDay #WomenWhoRun #RunnerLife".
